environment.timing_policy: Sequential warm-cache full command observations, no compilation/testing during timing; no statistical confidence or cross-platform speed claim.

input_manifest.title: MgSiO3 enstatite calibration crystal in a diamond-anvil cell
input_manifest.purpose: exposed development and regression data; complete workflow validation pending

redistribution.policy: Keep raw frames, source/reference files and derived observations external; no automatic download or upload.

raw_array.historical_orientation: vertical flip; preserve explicit coordinate convention

search_inputs.provenance: Cell, symmetry and wavelength transcribed from supplied source CIF; elements from declared sample. These are supplied priors, not blind indexing results. Coordinates, ADPs and atom counts are forbidden search inputs.

source_hkl_conversion.policy: Use reflection block through the first exact zero-index terminator; reject malformed/nonzero terminator intensity or sigma; archive trailer separately without parsing it as solver input.
source_hkl_conversion.reason: The supplied HKL appends SHELX instructions, including atomic model information, after the terminator. The strict public reader correctly rejects the unsplit file.

derived_observations.name: ours-own-sigma-observations.npz
derived_observations.origin: 2026-10-29 enstatite-from-raw-sensor-refit; previously calibrated and assigned raw-count rerun
derived_observations.qualification: An existing PhaseSmith reduction under fixed historical geometry/assignments; not a fresh end-to-end run.

assessment.reference_atom_count_use: post-search grading only; never used to set maximum_atoms

capacity_preflight.scope: Both source reflection block and archived PhaseSmith-reduced observations; unchanged corpus resource_atom_cap policy.

gates.known_group_previous_python_parity: Historical strict R1 and final-coordinate gates still fail; unchanged by this work. See native-coordinator-0.8-macos.json.
gates.unknown_initialization_change: v31 to v32 intentionally changes final R1 from 0.05141328789923159 to 0.051433695723409355; labelled structure recovery retained. v32 to v33 is bitwise identical excluding timers.

shelxt_comparison.binary: SHELXT 2018/2 x86_64 via Rosetta on Apple M4 Pro
shelxt_comparison.laue_group_supplied: mmm (inferred by the preceding native intensity assessment)
shelxt_comparison.qualification: Structure-solution stage only; no raw-frame reduction. Same signed native observations exported to SHELX fixed-width format with recorded rounding. No exact space-group flag, source HKLs, coordinates or correct atom counts supplied. The native bounded search and SHELXT schedules are different; no algorithm/coverage equivalence or general speed ratio follows.

binary_review.limitations: Inferred types/roles/control flow; main routine and outlined helpers unresolved; no decompiled code/constants translated or committed.

checks.numpy_only_installed_wheel_smoke: passed native detection, row search, solution and bundled Bitshuffle/LZ4 HDF5 decoding
checks.ruff: passed lint and format, 802 Python files

cleanup.policy: Removed only this worktree target and this task temporary documentation site, after preserving binaries, distributions, results and logs. Raw files, trials, frozen controls, historical receipts and shared caches retained.

limitations: Exposed regression example, not a blind validation dataset.
Supplied conventional primitive orthorhombic cell and explicit acquisition/mask assumptions.
345 metric-compatible settings assessed, 64 phase-screened, 12 atomic settings searched; uniqueness not proven.
No standalone single-crystal refinement, automatic cell conventionalization, anomalous/absolute-structure/twin/disorder completeness or new Python/Dioptas discovery bridge.
SHELXT supplied inferred mmm and standard HKLF rounding; different grids/cycles/objectives and Rosetta architecture, no equal-work general speed ratio.
